words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) opens 70:12 as continuation, not restart. It carries the ransom-price syntax from 70:11 into the new ayah, so the spouse-companion enters under the same exchange frame as the sons. Because the connector is fused directly to {{ar:صَٰحِبَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ṣāḥibatihī}}), the first beat of the ayah makes attachment audible before any new verb appears; the later {{ar:وَأَخِيهِ}} ({{tr:wa-akhīhi}}) then completes the paired wa-onset and hī-close rhythm.

words.prose: {{ar:صَٰحِبَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ṣāḥibatihī}}) names the wife through companionship: she is the close accompanying relation, not merely a bare marital category. The local kin list narrows the root to spouse-companion, while the active participle keeps lived nearness and ongoing association in view. Grammatically the noun is a possessed genitive item carried from 70:11, so the identifiable companion-wife is not standing in an independent clause; she is recast as part of the imagined ransom price. The dagger alif gives the first syllable a visible long-ā weight, and the same final possessive sound that will close {{ar:أَخِيهِ}} ({{tr:akhīhi}}) keeps both relationships tied to the same criminal; together they make the first kin term the heavier opening beat of the ayah's two-item fragment. The consort-denial uses of this wording for God (6:101; 72:3) sharpen the contrast: what is denied of God appears here as a human relation the criminal would surrender.

words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) adds {{ar:أَخِيهِ}} ({{tr:akhīhi}}) under the same remote ransom-price governance without repeating the preposition from 70:11. Its job is not ornamental: it keeps the brother separate from the spouse-companion while making both terms parallel entries in one catalogue. Because it is fused to the hamzated brother noun and repeats the earlier connector, the ayah turns from chosen companionship to sibling origin with a fresh list-beat instead of letting the shorter closing term be swallowed by the longer preceding word.

words.prose: {{ar:أَخِيهِ}} ({{tr:akhīhi}}) closes the ayah as a compact, possessed brother term. Its genitive form keeps the remote ransom construction from 70:11 active, and the suffix makes the brother the criminal's own, not a generic member of a class. The five-noun morphology marks that genitive with yāʾ, so the surface form is both archaically marked and syntactically bound; that same visible yāʾ also explains why the ʾ-kh-w and ʾ-kh-y root question can be noticed without changing the local parse. Lexically, the broader brotherhood and solidarity field is narrowed here to a singular personal brother; that narrowing matters because the expected bond of common origin and support is turned into an imagined surrender item, standing against the solidarity ideal in 49:10 and beside the kin-separation recurrence in 80:34. Its final position, shorter cadence, sharp glottal-and-khāʾ onset, and shared possessive close answer {{ar:صَٰحِبَتِهِۦ}} ({{tr:ṣāḥibatihī}}) while pointing forward to the wider clan term in 70:13.

topics.reason: The suffix is the genitive possessor of the kin noun and resolves to the masculine singular possessor established in the prior ayah.

topics.headline: special declension marks the governed case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brother term's yāʾ is not decorative; it is the five-noun genitive sign that locates the word inside the governed price list.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the form as one of the five special nouns with genitive case marked by yāʾ.

topics.headline: solidarity range is narrowed to one surrendered brother
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local word means his brother while still carrying the wider social value of brotherhood that the criminal would abandon.
topics.reason: The missing V4 root gives no contradiction; the possessed kin sequence selects the personal brother sense, while the CRITICAL evidence coherently preserves the wider affiliation and solidarity field, including the contrast with 49:10.

topics.headline: singular special noun resists a broad brethren reading
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah chooses a singular possessed brother before the list widens to clan, not a plural brethren field.
topics.reason: The local form is the special singular kin noun, while distributional evidence distinguishes that form from broader concrete brethren nouns.

topics.headline: genitive yāʾ makes the root dispute visible without changing the parse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices why the surface yāʾ can matter lexically even though the local grammar still treats it as the genitive ending of the special noun.
topics.reason: The contested ancestry is useful as morphology apparatus, but the canonical local parse remains the genitive special noun with a possessive suffix.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two coordinated possessed nouns name his female companion and his brother.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus pairs sustained companionship with sibling kinship, placing chosen or lived nearness beside given genealogical nearness.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and close association make the feminine relation a sustained intimate bond rather than a bare household label.
Brotherhood and kinship supply the inherited sibling bond that complements companionship.

changed_reading.before: A flat mention of a wife and a brother.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately paired anatomy of intimate nearness: sustained companionship and blood kinship.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The companion and brother can each be read through a branch of relational support or binding.
baseline_models.mechanism: One relation accompanies protectively while the other binds through a tether-like protected obligation, so the pair forms two kinds of social security.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies care that remains beside a person and makes the companion a sheltering relation.
A tethering bond and protected obligation supply the brother as a binding relation of claim and security.

changed_reading.after: Two support structures normally expected to accompany, bind, and protect him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The governing ransom action converts the focus pair from relations with intrinsic claims into proposed substitutes offered for the self.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship supplies the intimate bond whose value is being converted into an exchange object.
Sibling kinship supplies the non-substitutable blood bond that the proposed exchange nevertheless treats as substitutable.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the exchange operation that turns both focus relations into substitute payment.

structural_cues: The focus nouns are coordinated continuations of the ransom construction begun in 70:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intimate bonds under a ransom verb; I infer a conversion from relation to payment, while the live alternative is that the list expresses panic without a worked exchange logic.

changed_reading.before: The companion and brother are merely among the people he remembers.
changed_reading.after: They are relational value that self-preservation attempts to liquidate as substitute payment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, reciprocal asking between intimates is negated even though they are made mutually visible; the possessed pair is therefore present to sight but unavailable for reciprocal aid.

activation_trace.role: Close association establishes the reciprocity normally expected from the companion.
Sibling kinship establishes the reciprocal family claim that the context disables.
Mutual asking supplies the reciprocal social act whose explicit negation leaves the focus bonds one-sided.
Close kinship supplies the intimate-to-intimate relation that fails to produce inquiry or aid.
Physical seeing keeps the relatives perceptually present, making their social unavailability sharper rather than explaining it by absence.

structural_cues: 70:10 negates intimate-to-intimate asking, 70:11 makes them visible, and the focus then names two possessed intimates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated mutual asking, visual exposure, and close relations; I infer that perception survives while reciprocity collapses, though alternatively the clauses may only stage separate features of universal distraction.

changed_reading.before: The focus presents two mutually available close relations.
changed_reading.after: It presents visible but socially unreachable intimates, reduced to objects of a unilateral wish.

context_deltas.mechanism: The companion and brother form the middle ring in an expanding social map: descendants, intimate and collateral kin, sheltering clan, then the total human field.

activation_trace.role: Close companionship supplies the household-intimate side of the middle social ring.
Sibling kinship supplies the collateral-family side of the middle social ring.
Sonship, lineage, and attribution supply the descending family ring that precedes the focus pair.
A man's clan supplies the broader kin ring immediately after the focus.
Gathering and sheltering give the clan its functional role as the outer protective home.
Wholeness without dispersion or lack closes the expansion at everyone on earth.

structural_cues: The list advances from sons in 70:11 through the focus pair to clan in 70:13 and everyone on earth in 70:14.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered widening list and branch-specific kinds of relation; I infer concentric social radius, while an alternative is simple rhetorical accumulation without ring structure.

changed_reading.before: The companion and brother are two arbitrary entries in a family list.
changed_reading.after: They are the hinge that moves the list from direct descent to sheltering clan and finally universal scope.

context_deltas.mechanism: Relations whose branch images normally accompany and bind protectively are reversed: no power can repel the event, and the self imagines achieving separation and rescue by surrendering those very protections.

activation_trace.role: Protective accompaniment supplies the companion as care that should remain beside another.
The tether and protected obligation supply brotherhood as a binding security rather than a disposable object.
Removing a hated harm supplies the protective action that the context declares unavailable.
Escape by separation supplies the desired outcome, exposing why the self tries to detach from its closest bonds.

structural_cues: The no-defender statement precedes the family list, while the hoped-for rescue concludes that list.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unavailable defense, desired rescue by separation, and two protective focus branches; I infer a reversal in the direction of protection, while alternatively the branch images may only enrich the irony without defining the list's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The companion and brother are possible sources of support.
changed_reading.after: Their normal protection is inverted into self-protection at their expense: he seeks separation from the very bonds that should hold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wider context contrasts withholding a rightful material due with offering human relations as ransom; the focus pair becomes the wrong gift produced by a self that would not make the right gift.

activation_trace.role: Close companionship supplies a person with relational claims who is wrongly treated as transferable value.
Brotherly kinship supplies a second claimant whose person is substituted for a due payment.
Giving one thing as ransom for another supplies the attempted but morally displaced expenditure.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the prior economy of refusal that the desperate ransom reverses too late and onto persons.
A binding due and fixed entitlement supply the legitimate object of giving against which the human ransom is misdirected.

structural_cues: The later human portrait moves from withholding good to an acknowledged due for the asker and deprived, after the earlier family-ransom sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ransom, withholding, and a fixed due; I infer one moral economy in which refused giving returns as misdirected giving, while a live alternative is that the later general human portrait is not meant to diagnose this particular criminal wish.

changed_reading.before: The pair is offered because panic makes every sacrifice imaginable.
changed_reading.after: The pair is an illegitimate substitute payment from one who withheld legitimate claims: persons are spent where a due was not.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later portrait of sincere companionship, guarded intimacies, and preserved covenant provides an ethical counter-mechanism to the focus speaker's instrumental use of companion and brother.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship supplies the relationship whose fidelity is being tested by the ransom wish.
The tether-like protected obligation supplies brotherhood as a claim to be kept rather than traded away.
Truthfulness in affection and companionship supplies a direct positive mode for sustaining the focus relation.
Guarding sanctities, covenant, and chastity supplies disciplined preservation of intimate boundaries.
A preserved covenant that secures its holder supplies the durable obligation opposed to abandoning kin for rescue.

structural_cues: The repeated later clauses describing those who maintain obligations form a counter-pattern to the earlier possessive ransom list.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies positive branches of sincere companionship, guarded intimacy, and covenant; I infer that they judge the focus wish as relational infidelity, while alternatively the later virtues may describe salvation without directly commenting on these named bonds.

changed_reading.before: The companion and brother are passive casualties of terror.
changed_reading.after: They expose a failure of covenant fidelity, sharpened by the later image of people who preserve rather than monetize obligations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening near/far reversal migrates from time into social space: when the supposedly distant event becomes near, the person's nearest relations are treated as if they were the expendable far ones.

activation_trace.role: Close sustained association makes the companion a primary measure of social nearness.
Sibling kinship makes the brother another primary measure of relational nearness.
The distant ones as the opposite of relatives supplies an explicitly social edge within the context's language of distance.
Kinship and womb-nearness supply the relational sense of proximity that can reactivate the focus pair.

structural_cues: The explicit far/near opposition precedes a list ordered by degrees of intimate relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal far/near language with branches that also distinguish relatives from distant people; I infer a cross-domain reversal into social distance, while the materially live alternative keeps temporal and kinship proximity separate.

changed_reading.before: The focus simply names the nearest people.
changed_reading.after: It dramatizes distorted distance: the event judged far is near, while the people actually near are mentally pushed far enough away to spend.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a material hide branch far from the ordinary relational sense; it remains anchored in the focus companion root and gains a visible attached-versus-torn mechanism from 70:16; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for attachment, never as the lexical meaning of the focus noun.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The companion root has an image of a hide kept with hair or wool attached close upon it.

activation_trace.role: A hide retained with its hair or wool attached supplies a material image for an intimate layer that remains close to the self.
Pulling a thing from its settled place converts intimate attachedness into violent removal.
Extremities and nonvital outer parts give the stripping mechanism a bodily perimeter.

changed_reading.before: The companion is one social item offered in the list.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the closest companion is an attached layer the self would peel away, anticipating a fire that strips bodily edges.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a brotherhood branch to the final spatial scene rather than to ordinary kin semantics; it remains anchored in the brother root's tether image and the packet's rapid movement toward an erected marker; downstream prose should qualify it as an orientation analogy, not identify brotherhood with the marker.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The brother root carries a tether-loop and protected-bond image capable of orienting where one belongs.

activation_trace.role: A tethering loop and protected obligation supply brotherhood as a living bond that locates and restrains the self.
Speed as the opposite of slowness supplies the compelled directional rush that replaces stable belonging.
An erected boundary or marker supplies the fixed terminal orientation toward which the severed social self runs.

changed_reading.before: The brother is simply a close relative abandoned for rescue.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, abandoning the living tether of brotherhood leaves an imposed marker, rather than a relation, to determine direction.

strongest_changes: The ransom syntax converts sustained companionship and sibling kinship into proposed substitute payment.
Negated reciprocal asking and preserved sight turn the pair into visible but socially unreachable intimates.
The focus is the middle ring in an expansion from descendants through intimate and collateral kin to clan and all humanity.
Protective accompaniment and binding obligation reverse into self-protection at the relations' expense.
summary.what_was_special: The focus-only branches distinguish lived companionship, blood kinship, accompanying protection, and tethered obligation; context then activates exchange, failed reciprocity, social radius, protection reversal, and covenant failure rather than leaving a generic family list.
remaining_uncertainties: The misdirected-giving and covenant models depend on reading the later general human and virtuous portraits as commentary on the earlier criminal wish.
The near/far transfer from temporal judgment to social distance is coherent but cross-domain.
The attached-layer and terminal-marker readings are branch-backed analogies only and should not be rendered as lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Sustained companionship is converted into expendable proximity.** *Ṣāḥibatihi* activates **ص ح ب, B001, “companionship and close association,”** and **B002, “protective accompaniment.”** The coordination with brother continues the ransom list rather than a care list. I infer that the companion’s ordinary role would be to accompany and protect, but the criminal reverses the arrow and seeks protection by surrendering the companion. The ayah reads as an inversion of what companionship does.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The custodial sequence in 70:29–34 made **ص ح ب B002**, protective accompaniment, more visible. Later guardianship exposes the ransom wish as a reversal of the care ordinarily carried by companionship.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın merkezini erkek ve kadın kardeş ile kardeşlik ilişkisi olarak doğrular. Arkadaşlar için kullanılan çoğul biçim, doğumdan gelen kardeşlikle aynı düzeyde bir temel anlam değil, kardeşlik benzetmesine dayanan bir kullanım eğilimidir; birini kardeş edinme ise yalnızca ayrı sözlü yapılarda gösterilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, doğum ve soy bağına dayanan kardeşliği merkez alır; arkadaşlık ve sonradan kardeş sayma kullanımları bu merkeze bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kişi ve ilişki adları ile belirli sözlü yapılar birlikte bulunduğundan, temel kardeşlik anlamı bu yapılara özgü edinme ve karşılıklı bağ kurma anlamlarıyla birleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı doğum veya soy bağı içinde erkek ya da kadın kardeş olma ve bu kişileri adlandırma alanıdır. Arkadaşların kardeş sayılması, temel soy bağının arkadaşlığa benzetilerek genişletilmiş bir kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Temel alan, erkek ve kadın kardeşleri ve aralarındaki doğum ya da soy bağını kapsar.
